description: This file defines the PayGrade entity class within a Human Resource Management system, mapping to the 'ohrm_pay_grade' database table. It includes properties for id, name, and related pay grade currencies, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Represents a pay grade with a unique identifier, optional name, and associated currencies in the system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated pay grade currencies.

methods.name: setPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Assigns a collection of pay grade currencies.
